title: Madhya-khanda, part 4 (portion 27)
html:
The Lord expounds the path of knowledge and proclaims what is highest — bhakti; meditation on Radha and Krishna in Vrindavana; Advaita comes to Navadvipa; the Lord with His club threatens the haters of devotees; Advaita's dance; the truth about Advaita; the ban on speculating about the Self; a song of the beauty of dancing Gaura

Raga varadi; refrain: "I take upon myself all misfortunes of Gora's beauty! He has given away the treasure of prema, filling the world with it"

তবে সেই মহাপ্রভু বসি' নিজঘরে ।
অধ্যাত্মতত্ত্বের কথা কহয়ে ঈশ্বরে ॥ ৩৬ ॥

tabe sei mahāprabhu basi' nijaghare |
adhyātmatattbera kathā kahaẏe īśbare || 36 ||

tabe sei mahaprabhu — then Mahaprabhu; basi nija-ghare — sitting in His own house; adhyatma-tattvera katha — of the truth of the Self; kahaye ishvare — the Ishvara speaks

36Then Mahaprabhu, sitting in His own house,
the Ishvara, speaks of the truth of the Self (adhyatma-tattva):

একমাত্র কৃষ্ণ স্বামী সৃষ্টি-স্থিতি ।
আপনে সে এক আত্মা-রূপে আছে ক্ষিতি ॥ ৩৭ ॥

ekamātra kṛṣṇa sbāmī sṛṣṭi-sthiti |
āpane se eka ātmā-rūpe āche kṣiti || 37 ||

eka-matra krishna svami — Krishna alone is the Master; srishti-sthiti — creation and maintenance; apane se — He Himself; eka atma-rupe — as the one Soul; achhe kshiti — abides on earth

37"Krishna alone is the Master, the creation and maintenance [of the world];
He Himself, as the one Soul, abides [in all] on earth."

ইহা বলি' হস্ত মেলি' পুনঃ করে মুষ্টি ।
দেখায় সভারে এইমত মোর সৃষ্টি ॥ ৩৮ ॥

ihā bali' hasta meli' punaḥ kare muṣṭi |
dekhāẏa sabhāre eimata mora sṛṣṭi || 38 ||

iha bali — saying this; hasta meli — opening His hand; punah kare mushti — again makes a fist; dekhaya sabhare — shows all; eimata mora srishti — such is My creation

38Saying this, He opened His hand and again closed it into a fist,
showing everyone: "Such is My creation."

পুনঃ কহে তত্ত্ব সত্তামাত্র-স্বরূপিণ ।
ভাবের আবেশ তাথে শুন সর্বজন ॥ ৩৯ ॥

punaḥ kahe tattba sattāmātra-sbarūpiṇa |
bhābera ābeśa tāthe śuna sarbajana || 39 ||

punah kahe — again He says; tattva satta-matra-svarupina — the Truth is by nature pure being; bhavera avesha tathe — absorption in it; shuna sarvajana — hear, all

39And again He says: "The Truth is by nature pure being;
hear, all of you, what absorption in it is.

তথাপি সদ্রূপ সেই করিয়ে যতন ।
এক জ্ঞান বিনে মুক্ত নহে এ কারণ ॥ ৪০ ॥

tathāpi sadrūpa sei kariẏe yatana |
eka jñāna bine mukta nahe e kāraṇa || 40 ||

tathapi — and yet; sad-rupa sei — for that true being; kariye yatana — they strive; eka jnana vine — without knowledge of the One; mukta nahe — there is no liberation; e karana — for this reason

40And yet people strive for that true being:
without knowledge of the One there is no liberation — that is why.

বিষম সংসারবন্ধ জিনিতে না পারে ।
মুক্তবন্ধ হয় যদি একজ্ঞান করে ॥ ৪১ ॥

biṣama saṃsārabandha jinite nā pāre |
muktabandha haẏa yadi ekajñāna kare || 41 ||

vishama samsara-bandha — the grievous bonds of samsara; jinite na pare — cannot conquer; mukta-bandha haya — the bonds are loosed; yadi eka-jnana kare — if one gains knowledge of the One

41[Without it] one cannot conquer the grievous bonds of samsara;
if one gains knowledge of the One, the bonds fall away.

মুক্তি বিনু কৃষ্ণজ্ঞান নাহি হয় কভু ।
এতেক বলিয়ে শুন জ্ঞানগম্য প্রভু ॥ ৪২ ॥

mukti binu kṛṣṇajñāna nāhi haẏa kabhu |
eteka baliẏe śuna jñānagamya prabhu || 42 ||

mukti vinu — without liberation; krishna-jnana nahi haya kabhu — there is never knowledge of Krishna; eteka baliye — therefore I say; shuna — hear; jnana-gamya prabhu — the Lord is reached through knowledge

42Without liberation there is never knowledge of Krishna;
therefore I say: hear — the Lord is reached through knowledge1.

হের দেখ আমার করে এ পাঁচ অঙ্গুলি ।
মধুতে মিশ্রিত এক ঘৃণাকর চারি ॥ ৪৩ ॥

hera dekha āmāra kare e pāṁca aṅguli |
madhute miśrita eka ghṛṇākara cāri || 43 ||

hera dekha — here, look; amara kare — on My hand; e pancha anguli — these five fingers; madhute mishrita eka — one smeared with honey; ghrinakara chari — four are repulsive

43Here, look at these five fingers of My hand:
one is smeared with honey, four with something repulsive.

দুর্গন্ধ লাগিয়া তাহা না চাহে নয়নে ।
একাঙ্গুলি মধু জিহ্বা লিহায় যতনে ॥ ৪৪ ॥

durgandha lāgiẏā tāhā nā cāhe naẏane |
ekāṅguli madhu jihbā lihāẏa yatane || 44 ||

durgandha lagiya — because of the stench; taha na chahe nayane — one does not look at them; ekanguli madhu — the one honeyed finger; jihva lihaya yatane — one carefully licks with the tongue

44Because of the stench one does not even want to look at them,
but the finger with honey one carefully licks with the tongue.

এক অব্যয় সেই ভগবান্ মাত্র ।
ইহা বহি' মুক্ত হইবারে নাহি পাত্র ॥ ৪৫ ॥

eka abyaẏa sei bhagabān mātra |
ihā bahi' mukta haibāre nāhi pātra || 45 ||

eka avyaya — the One, the Imperishable; sei bhagavan matra — is Bhagavan alone; iha bahi — apart from Him; mukta haibare — to be liberated; nahi patra — there is no means

45The One, the Imperishable is Bhagavan alone;
apart from Him there is nothing by which to be liberated."

এইমতে জ্ঞানযোগ কহে নানাবিধি ।
ক্ষণেক রহিলা নিঃশবদে গুণনিধি ॥ ৪৬ ॥

eimate jñānayoga kahe nānābidhi |
kṣaṇeka rahilā niḥśabade guṇanidhi || 46 ||

eimate — thus; jnana-yoga kahe nana-vidhi — sets forth the path of knowledge in many ways; kshaneka rahila nihshabade — for a moment fell silent; guna-nidhi — the Ocean of virtues

46Thus in many ways He set forth the path of knowledge (jnana-yoga)
and for a moment fell silent — the Ocean of virtues.

দয়া করি' পুনঃ কহে সর্বতত্ত্বসার ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণভকতি বিনে কিছু নাহি আর ॥ ৪৭ ॥

daẏā kari' punaḥ kahe sarbatattbasāra |
śrīkṛṣṇabhakati bine kichu nāhi āra || 47 ||

daya kari — out of mercy; punah kahe — again He says; sarva-tattva-sara — the essence of all truths; shri-krishna-bhakati vine — without devotion to Sri Krishna; kichhu nahi ara — there is nothing else

47Then, out of mercy, He again speaks the essence of all truths:
"Without devotion to Sri Krishna there is nothing else."

জ্ঞানগম্য কৃষ্ণ ইহা বুঝাইল সভারে ।
কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজে প্রেমভক্তি সর্বসারে ॥ ৪৮ ॥

jñānagamya kṛṣṇa ihā bujhāila sabhāre |
kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuje premabhakti sarbasāre || 48 ||

jnana-gamya krishna — Krishna is reached through knowledge; iha bujhaila sabhare — this He explained to all; krishna-padambuje prema-bhakti — prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet; sarva-sare — the essence of all

48He explained to all: "Krishna is reached through knowledge,
[but] prema-bhakti for Krishna's lotus feet is the essence of all.

এই জ্ঞান হইলে হয় কৃষ্ণে দৃঢ়মতি ।
মতি দৃঢ়া হৈলে হয় ভক্তি অহৈতুকী ॥ ৪৯ ॥

ei jñāna haile haẏa kṛṣṇe dṛṛhamati |
mati dṛṛhā haile haẏa bhakti ahaitukī || 49 ||

ei jnana haile — when this knowledge comes; haya krishne dridha-mati — the mind is fixed firmly on Krishna; mati dridha haile — when the mind is firm; haya bhakti ahaituki — causeless bhakti arises

49When this knowledge comes, the mind turns firmly to Krishna;
when the mind is firm, causeless bhakti arises"2.

কৃষ্ণ-পাদাম্বুজ-ধ্যান করিল তখন ।
হরিহরি বলি' পাদাম্বুজ-সঙরণ ॥ ৫০ ॥

kṛṣṇa-pādāmbuja-dhyāna karila takhana |
harihari bali' pādāmbuja-saṅaraṇa || 50 ||

krishna-padambuja-dhyana — meditation on Krishna's lotus feet; karila takhana — then He did; hari-hari bali — crying "Hari, Hari!"; padambuja-sanarana — remembrance of the lotus feet

50Then He became absorbed in meditation on Krishna's lotus feet
and, crying "Hari, Hari!", remembered His lotus feet:

রাধা-সঙ্গে চিদানন্দ শ্যাম ত্রিভঙ্গী ।
মদন-মোহন নটবর বহুরঙ্গী ॥ ৫১ ॥

rādhā-saṅge cidānanda śyāma tribhaṅgī |
madana-mohana naṭabara bahuraṅgī || 51 ||

radha-sange — with Radha; chid-ananda — consciousness and bliss; shyama tribhangi — dark, thrice-bent; madana-mohana — enchanter of Kamadeva; natavara — the best of dancers; bahu-rangi — of many sports

51together with Radha — dark, thrice-bent, [the embodiment of] consciousness and bliss,
the enchanter of Kamadeva, the best of dancers, of many sports,

বৃন্দাবন-মাঝে নব-রতন-মন্দিরে ।
বল্লবসুন্দরী সব বেড়ি' মনোহরে ॥ ৫২ ॥

bṛndābana-mājhe naba-ratana-mandire |
ballabasundarī saba beṛi' manohare || 52 ||

vrindavana-majhe — in Vrindavana; nava-ratana-mandire — in a new temple of jewels; ballava-sundari saba — all the beautiful cowherd girls; bedi — surrounding; manohare — the Captivating One

52in Vrindavana, in a new temple of jewels,
captivating, surrounded by the beautiful cowherd girls.

কোকিল ময়ূর সারী শুক অলিকুলে ।
প্রফুল্লিত বৃন্দাবন শোভে নানাফুলে ॥ ৫৩ ॥

kokila maẏūra sārī śuka alikule |
praphullita bṛndābana śobhe nānāphule || 53 ||

kokila mayura sari shuka — cuckoos, peacocks, sarikas, parrots; alikule — swarms of bees; praphullita vrindavana — Vrindavana in bloom; shobhe nana-phule — is adorned with many flowers

53Cuckoos, peacocks, sarikas, parrots, swarms of bees;
Vrindavana in full bloom is adorned with many flowers.

চিন্তামণি-ভূমি কল্পতরুগণ যত ।
কামধেনুগণ যেন সুরভিগণযুত ॥ ৫৪ ॥

cintāmaṇi-bhūmi kalpatarugaṇa yata |
kāmadhenugaṇa yena surabhigaṇayuta || 54 ||

chintamani-bhumi — ground of chintamani; kalpa-taru-gana yata — all the wish-fulfilling trees; kamadhenu-gana — the kamadhenu cows; yena surabhi-gana-yuta — like herds of surabhis

54The ground is chintamani, everywhere wish-fulfilling trees,
the kamadhenu cows like herds of surabhis.

যমুনা-বেষ্টিত মনোহর অতি শোভা ।
সে রস-লাবণ্য দেখি' লক্ষ্মী মনোলোভা ॥ ৫৫ ॥

yamunā-beṣṭita manohara ati śobhā |
se rasa-lābaṇya dekhi' lakṣmī manolobhā || 55 ||

yamuna-veshtita — girdled by the Yamuna; manohara ati shobha — captivating, most beautiful; se rasa-lavanya dekhi — seeing that rasa and loveliness; lakshmi mano-lobha — Lakshmi longs at heart

55Girdled by the Yamuna, captivating, full of beauty —
seeing that rasa and loveliness, Lakshmi is filled with longing3.

উঠিল প্রেমের ধারা বহে দুনয়ানে ।
পুলকিত কলেবর অরুণ নয়ানে ॥ ৫৬ ॥

uṭhila premera dhārā bahe dunaẏāne |
pulakita kalebara aruṇa naẏāne || 56 ||

uthila premera dhara — a stream of prema rose; bahe dunayane — flows from both eyes; pulakita kalebara — the body thrills; aruna nayane — the eyes red

56A stream of prema rose and flows from both His eyes,
His body thrills, His eyes are red.

ক্ষণে হাসে ক্ষণে কান্দে ক্ষণে নাচে গায় ।
কহিল সবারে প্রভু গদগদ-ভাষায় ॥ ৫৭ ॥

kṣaṇe hāse kṣaṇe kānde kṣaṇe nāce gāẏa |
kahila sabāre prabhu gadagada-bhāṣāẏa || 57 ||

kshane hase — now He laughs; kshane kande — now weeps; kshane nache gaya — now dances and sings; kahila sabare prabhu — the Lord said to all; gadgada-bhashaya — in a faltering voice

57Now He laughs, now weeps, now dances and sings;
in a faltering voice the Lord said to all:

ঐছন আমার যেই যেই ভক্তগণ ।
নিজগুণে পবিত্র করয়ে ত্রিভুবন ॥ ৫৮ ॥

aichana āmāra yei yei bhaktagaṇa |
nijaguṇe pabitra karaẏe tribhubana || 58 ||

aichhana — such are; amara yei yei bhakta-gana — all My devotees; nija-gune — by their virtues; pavitra karaye tribhuvana — purify the three worlds

58"Such are all My devotees:
by their virtues they purify the three worlds."

ইহা বলি' হৃষ্ট হঞা নিজভক্ত-সনে ।
নাচায় সভারে প্রভু নাচয়ে আপনে ॥ ৫৯ ॥

ihā bali' hṛṣṭa hañā nijabhakta-sane |
nācāẏa sabhāre prabhu nācaẏe āpane || 59 ||

iha bali — saying this; hrishta hana — joyful; nija-bhakta-sane — with His devotees; nachaya sabhare prabhu — the Lord makes all dance; nachaye apane — dances Himself

59Saying this, the Lord, joyful, with His devotees
makes them all dance and dances Himself.

এইমতে সুখে নিবসয়ে নবদ্বীপে ।
নিজভক্তগণ মেলি' গঙ্গার সমীপে ॥ ৬০ ॥

eimate sukhe nibasaẏe nabadbīpe |
nijabhaktagaṇa meli' gaṅgāra samīpe || 60 ||

eimate — thus; sukhe nivasaye navadvipe — He lives happily in Navadvipa; nija-bhakta-gana meli — together with His devotees; gangara samipe — near the Ganga

60Thus He lives happily in Navadvipa
together with His devotees, by the Ganga.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য-গোসাঞি তবে আর দিনে ।
নবদ্বীপে আইলা বিশ্বম্ভর-দরশনে ॥ ৬১ ॥

adbaita-ācārya-gosāñi tabe āra dine |
nabadbīpe āilā biśbambhara-daraśane || 61 ||

advaita-acharya-gosani — Advaita Acharya Gosani; tabe ara dine — then on another day; navadvipe aila — came to Navadvipa; vishvambhara-darashane — to see Vishvambhara

61And then on another day Advaita Acharya Gosani
came to Navadvipa to see Vishvambhara.

গিয়াছিলা মহাপ্রভু শ্রীনিবাস-ঘরে ।
আগমন চাহি' আচার্য স্নানপূজা করে ॥ ৬২ ॥

giẏāchilā mahāprabhu śrīnibāsa-ghare |
āgamana cāhi' ācārya snānapūjā kare || 62 ||

giyachhila mahaprabhu — Mahaprabhu had gone; shrinibasa-ghare — to Srinivasa's house; agamana chahi — intending to come; acharya snana-puja kare — the Acharya performs bath and worship

62Mahaprabhu had gone to Srinivasa's house;
the Acharya, about to come [to Him], performs His bath and worship.

শ্রীনিবাস-ঘরে প্রভু আনন্দিত মনে ।
দণ্ডাগ্রে পুষ্প দিয়া কহিল বচনে ॥ ৬৩ ॥

śrīnibāsa-ghare prabhu ānandita mane |
daṇḍāgre puṣpa diẏā kahila bacane || 63 ||

shrinibasa-ghare — in Srinivasa's house; prabhu anandita mane — the Lord with a joyful heart; dandagre pushpa diya — placing a flower on the tip of a staff; kahila bachane — said

63In Srinivasa's house the Lord, with a joyful heart,
placing a flower on the tip of a staff, said:

গদাপূজা কৈল এই দুষ্ট নাশিবারে ।
আমার ভকত-হিংসা যেই যেই করে ॥ ৬৪ ॥

gadāpūjā kaila ei duṣṭa nāśibāre |
āmāra bhakata-hiṃsā yei yei kare || 64 ||

gada-puja kaila — I have worshipped the club; ei dushta nashibare — to destroy these wicked ones; amara bhakata-himsa — harm to My devotees; yei yei kare — all who do

64"I have worshipped the club to destroy these wicked ones —
all who do harm to My devotees.

ইহাতে নাশিব আমি সেই সেই জন ।
সভা-বিদ্যমানে প্রভু কহিল বচন ॥ ৬৫ ॥

ihāte nāśiba āmi sei sei jana |
sabhā-bidyamāne prabhu kahila bacana || 65 ||

ihate — with this; nashiba ami — I shall destroy; sei sei jana — all such people; sabha-vidyamane — in the presence of all; prabhu kahila bachana — the Lord said

65With it I shall destroy all such people" —
so the Lord spoke in the presence of all.

মোর ভক্তদ্বেষী এক আছে দুষ্টজন ।
কুষ্ঠব্যাধি হইবে তার অনেক জনম ॥ ৬৬ ॥

mora bhaktadbeṣī eka āche duṣṭajana |
kuṣṭhabyādhi haibe tāra aneka janama || 66 ||

mora bhakta-dveshi — a hater of My devotees; eka achhe dushta-jana — there is one wicked man; kushtha-vyadhi haibe tara — he will have leprosy; aneka janama — for many births

66"There is one wicked man, a hater of My devotees:
he will suffer leprosy for many births.

পৈশাচ-নরকে বাস করাইব আমি ।
বিড়্ভুজ শূকর সেই হইবে আপনি ॥ ৬৭ ॥

paiśāca-narake bāsa karāiba āmi |
biṛbhuja śūkara sei haibe āpani || 67 ||

paishacha-narake — in the hell of the pishachas; basa karaiba ami — I shall make him dwell; vid-bhuja shukara — a filth-eating hog; sei haibe apani — he himself will become

67I shall make him dwell in the hell of the pishachas;
he himself will become a hog that eats filth.

তাহার শিষ্যের আমি করাইব দণ্ড ।
আমার গদায় সব নাশিব পাষণ্ড ॥ ৬৮ ॥

tāhāra śiṣyera āmi karāiba daṇḍa |
āmāra gadāẏa saba nāśiba pāṣaṇḍa || 68 ||

tahara shishyera — his disciples; ami karaiba danda — I shall punish; amara gadaya — with My club; saba nashiba pashanda — I shall destroy all the godless

68I shall punish his disciples too;
with My club I shall destroy all the godless4.

বনেরে যাইব বলি' ছিল মোর মন ।
এথাই আমার সেই হৈল মহাবন ॥ ৬৯ ॥

banere yāiba bali' chila mora mana |
ethāi āmāra sei haila mahābana || 69 ||

banere yaiba bali — "I will go to the forest"; chhila mora mana — so I had thought; ethai — right here; amara sei haila mahabana — has become that great forest for Me

69I had thought to go to the forest —
but here for Me is that great forest:

ব্যাঘ্রসদৃশ কেহো কেহো বা পাষাণ ।
বৃক্ষের সদৃশ কেহো তৃণের সমান ॥ ৭০ ॥

byāghrasadṛśa keho keho bā pāṣāṇa |
bṛkṣera sadṛśa keho tṛṇera samāna || 70 ||

vyaghra-sadrisha keho — some are like tigers; keho ba pashana — others like stones; vrikshera sadrisha keho — some like trees; trinera samana — [others] like grass

70some are like tigers, others like stones,
some are like trees, others like grass,

পশুর সমান করি' গণি কোন জন ।
এতেক বলিয়ে মোরে এই মহাবন ॥ ৭১ ॥

paśura samāna kari' gaṇi kona jana |
eteka baliẏe more ei mahābana || 71 ||

pashura samana kari — as cattle; gani kona jana — some I count; eteka baliye — therefore I say; more ei mahabana — this is a great forest for Me

71and some I count as cattle —
that is why I say: this is a great forest for Me5.

অদ্বৈত-আচার্য এথা আইল ইহা শুনি ।
এথা না আইলা তথা যাইব আপনি ॥ ৭২ ॥

adbaita-ācārya ethā āila ihā śuni |
ethā nā āilā tathā yāiba āpani || 72 ||

advaita-acharya etha aila — Advaita Acharya has come here; iha shuni — so I hear; etha na aila — [if] He does not come here; tatha yaiba apani — I shall go there Myself

72I have heard that Advaita Acharya has come here;
if He does not come here, I shall go there Myself."

হেনই সময়ে আচার্য আইলা আচম্বিত ।
প্রভুর সম্মুখে গিয়া হৈলা উপনীত ॥ ৭৩ ॥

henai samaẏe ācārya āilā ācambita |
prabhura sammukhe giẏā hailā upanīta || 73 ||

henai samaye — at that very time; acharya aila achambita — the Acharya suddenly came; prabhura sammukhe giya — going before the Lord; haila upanita — he presented himself

73At that very moment the Acharya suddenly came
and appeared before the Lord.

পাদাম্বুজ-সন্নিকটে উপায়ন দিয়া ।
দণ্ডপরণাম করে ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ॥ ৭৪ ॥

pādāmbuja-sannikaṭe upāẏana diẏā |
daṇḍaparaṇāma kare bhūmite paṛiẏā || 74 ||

padambuja-sannikate — near the lotus feet; upayana diya — placing gifts; danda-paranama kare — prostrates; bhumite padiya — falling to the ground

74Placing gifts near the lotus feet,
He fell to the ground and prostrated Himself.

তার কর ধরি' প্রভু বোলয়ে বচন ।
এথা আগমন মোর তোমার কারণ ॥ ৭৫ ॥

tāra kara dhari' prabhu bolaẏe bacana |
ethā āgamana mora tomāra kāraṇa || 75 ||

tara kara dhari — taking His hand; prabhu bolaye bachana — the Lord says; etha agamana mora — My coming here; tomara karana — is for Your sake

75Taking His hand, the Lord says:
"I have come here for Your sake.

মোর পাদপদ্ম নিজ মস্তকে ধরিয়া ।
তুলসী-মঞ্জরী দিয়া পূজিলে কান্দিয়া ॥ ৭৬ ॥

mora pādapadma nija mastake dhariẏā |
tulasī-mañjarī diẏā pūjile kāndiẏā || 76 ||

mora pada-padma — My lotus feet; nija mastake dhariya — holding on Your head; tulasi-manjari diya — offering tulasi buds; pujile kandiya — You worshipped, weeping

76You held My lotus feet on Your head
and, weeping, worshipped them, offering tulasi buds.

ভাগবতচিত্ত তুমি হুঙ্কারে আনিলা ।
তোমার পীরিতি লাগি' মোরে সভে পাইলা ॥ ৭৭ ॥

bhāgabatacitta tumi huṅkāre ānilā |
tomāra pīriti lāgi' more sabhe pāilā || 77 ||

bhagavata-chitta tumi — You, whose heart is a bhagavata's; hunkare anila — brought [Me] by loud calls; tomara piriti lagi — because of Your love; more sabhe paila — all have obtained Me

77You, whose heart is that of a bhagavata, brought [Me] with Your loud calls:
thanks to Your love all have obtained Me"6.

ইহা বলি' মহাপ্রভু খট্টায় বসিলা ।
নাচহ বলিয়া আচার্যেরে আজ্ঞা দিলা ॥ ৭৮ ॥

ihā bali' mahāprabhu khaṭṭāẏa basilā |
nācaha baliẏā ācāryere ājñā dilā || 78 ||

iha bali — saying this; mahaprabhu khattaya basila — Mahaprabhu sat on a couch; nachaha baliya — saying "dance"; acharyere ajna dila — gave the order to the Acharya

78Saying this, Mahaprabhu sat on a couch
and ordered the Acharya: "Dance!"

তবে সেই অদ্বৈত-আচার্য দ্বিজবর ।
দশ-অবতার-গীতে নাচিলা বিস্তর ॥ ৭৯ ॥

tabe sei adbaita-ācārya dbijabara |
daśa-abatāra-gīte nācilā bistara || 79 ||

tabe sei advaita-acharya — then Advaita Acharya; dvija-vara — the best of brahmanas; dasha-avatara-gite — to songs of the ten avataras; nachila vistara — danced at length

79Then Advaita Acharya, the best of brahmanas,
danced long to songs of the ten avataras.

শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত-আদি যত ভক্তগণ ।
আনন্দে বিভোর করে গুণসংকীর্তন ॥ ৮০ ॥

śrībāsapaṇḍita-ādi yata bhaktagaṇa |
ānande bibhora kare guṇasaṃkīrtana || 80 ||

shrivasa-pandita-adi — Srivasa Pandita and others; yata bhakta-gana — all the devotees; anande vibhora — beside themselves with joy; kare guna-sankirtana — sing the sankirtana of qualities

80Srivasa Pandita and all the other devotees,
beside themselves with joy, sing the sankirtana of His qualities.

তা দেখিয়া মহাপ্রভু গৌর ভগবান্ ।
হৃষ্ট হইয়া বৈল তারে প্রসন্নবয়ান ॥ ৮১ ॥

tā dekhiẏā mahāprabhu gaura bhagabān |
hṛṣṭa haiẏā baila tāre prasannabaẏāna || 81 ||

ta dekhiya — seeing this; mahaprabhu gaura bhagavan — Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan; hrishta haiya — pleased; baila tare — said to Him; prasanna-bayana — with a serene face

81Seeing this, Mahaprabhu Gaura Bhagavan,
pleased, said to Him with a serene face:

এ তোর বালক সব প্রেম মাগে মোরে ।
দিব প্রেমভক্তিদান কহিল তোমারে ॥ ৮২ ॥

e tora bālaka saba prema māge more |
diba premabhaktidāna kahila tomāre || 82 ||

e tora balaka saba — all these children of Yours; prema mage more — beg Me for prema; diba prema-bhakti-dana — I shall give the gift of prema-bhakti; kahila tomare — I tell You

82"All these children of Yours beg Me for prema;
I shall give them the gift of prema-bhakti — I tell You"7.

এ বোল শুনিঞা তুষ্ট হইলা আচার্য ।
অন্তরে জানিল মোর সিদ্ধ হৈল কার্য ॥ ৮৩ ॥

e bola śuniñā tuṣṭa hailā ācārya |
antare jānila mora siddha haila kārya || 83 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; tushta haila acharya — the Acharya was pleased; antare janila — He knew at heart; mora siddha haila karya — my work is accomplished

83Hearing these words, the Acharya rejoiced;
in His heart He knew: "My work is accomplished."

আচার্য কহয়ে প্রভু শুনহ বচন ।
এই-সব জন তোর পদপরায়ণ ॥ ৮৪ ॥

ācārya kahaẏe prabhu śunaha bacana |
ei-saba jana tora padaparāẏaṇa || 84 ||

acharya kahaye — the Acharya says; prabhu shunaha bachana — Lord, hear my words; ei-saba jana — all these people; tora pada-parayana — are devoted to Your feet

84The Acharya says: "Lord, hear me:
all these people are devoted to Your feet.

ভকতবৎসল তুমি করুণাসাগর ।
প্রেমধন দিয়া নিজ ভক্ত রক্ষা কর ॥ ৮৫ ॥

bhakatabatsala tumi karuṇāsāgara |
premadhana diẏā nija bhakta rakṣā kara || 85 ||

bhakata-vatsala tumi — You love Your devotees; karuna-sagara — ocean of compassion; premadhana diya — giving the treasure of prema; nija bhakta raksha kara — protect Your devotees

85You love Your devotees, You are an ocean of compassion:
giving them the treasure of prema, protect Your devotees."

তবে সেই সব জন প্রভু-পাশে গিয়া ।
বসিলা আসন করি' ঠাকুর বেড়িয়া ॥ ৮৬ ॥

tabe sei saba jana prabhu-pāśe giẏā |
basilā āsana kari' ṭhākura beṛiẏā || 86 ||

tabe sei saba jana — then all of them; prabhu-pashe giya — going to the Lord; basila asana kari — sat down; thakura bediya — around the Thakura

86Then all of them came to the Lord
and sat down around the Thakura.

সচন্দ্রিকা রজনী শোভিত দিগন্তর ।
আচার্য দেখিয়া পুনঃ কহিল উত্তর ॥ ৮৭ ॥

sacandrikā rajanī śobhita digantara |
ācārya dekhiẏā punaḥ kahila uttara || 87 ||

sachandrika rajani — a moonlit night; shobhita digantara — the quarters shining; acharya dekhiya — looking at the Acharya; punah kahila uttara — He spoke again

87The night was moonlit, the quarters shone;
looking at the Acharya, [the Lord] spoke again:

কমলাক্ষ তুমি মোর পরম ভকত ।
তোমার লাগিয়া আইনু হৈনু বেকত ॥ ৮৮ ॥

kamalākṣa tumi mora parama bhakata |
tomāra lāgiẏā āinu hainu bekata || 88 ||

kamalaksha — Kamalaksha; tumi mora parama bhakata — You are My greatest devotee; tomara lagiya ainu — for Your sake I came; hainu bekata — I became manifest

88"Kamalaksha, You are My greatest devotee:
for Your sake I have come, for Your sake I have appeared.

মোর গুণ-নৃত্য-গীতে হও তুমি সুখী ।
সর্বজন ভক্তিপর হউ ইহা দেখি' ॥ ৮৯ ॥

mora guṇa-nṛtya-gīte hao tumi sukhī |
sarbajana bhaktipara hau ihā dekhi' || 89 ||

mora guna-nritya-gite — in songs of My qualities and dance; hao tumi sukhi — be happy; sarvajana bhakti-para hau — may all become devoted; iha dekhi — seeing this

89Be happy singing My qualities and dancing;
may all people become devotees, seeing this."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সেই শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
কহয়ে ঠাকুর-আগে পরসন্ন চিত ॥ ৯০ ॥

e bola śuniñā sei śrībāsapaṇḍita |
kahaẏe ṭhākura-āge parasanna cita || 90 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; sei shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita; kahaye thakura-age — speaks before the Thakura; parasanna chita — with a serene heart

90Hearing these words, Srivasa Pandita,
with a serene heart, speaks before the Thakura:

এক নিবেদন করোঁ শুন মোর বোল ।
কহিতে ডরাঙ পুনঃ চিত উতরোল ॥ ৯১ ॥

eka nibedana karoṁ śuna mora bola |
kahite ḍarāṅa punaḥ cita utarola || 91 ||

eka nivedana karon — I have one request; shuna mora bola — hear my words; kahite darana — I am afraid to speak; punah chita utarola — yet my heart is restless

91"I wish to ask something — hear me;
I am afraid to speak, yet my heart is restless.

একটি সন্দেহ পুছোঁ হৃদয়ের কার্য ।
তোমার কি ভক্ত এই অদ্বৈত আচার্য ॥ ৯২ ॥

ekaṭi sandeha puchoṁ hṛdaẏera kārya |
tomāra ki bhakta ei adbaita ācārya || 92 ||

ekati sandeha — one doubt; puchhon — I ask; hridayera karya — what is in my heart; tomara ki bhakta — is he Your devotee; ei advaita acharya — this Advaita Acharya

92I have one doubt, and that is what I ask:
is this Advaita Acharya really Your devotee?"

ইহা শুনি' ক্রোধমুখ গৌর ভগবান্ ।
ভর্ৎসিতে লাগিলা ক্রোধে অরুণনয়ান ॥ ৯৩ ॥

ihā śuni' krodhamukha gaura bhagabān |
bhartsite lāgilā krodhe aruṇanaẏāna || 93 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; krodha-mukha — with an angry face; gaura bhagavan — Gaura Bhagavan; bhartsite lagila — began to rebuke; krodhe aruna-nayana — His eyes red with anger

93Hearing this, Gaura Bhagavan, His face angry,
His eyes red with anger, began to rebuke him:

উদ্ধব অক্রূর মোর প্রিয় দুইজন ।
আচার্য বাসহ তুমি তা-সভাকে ন্যূন ॥ ৯৪ ॥

uddhaba akrūra mora priẏa duijana |
ācārya bāsaha tumi tā-sabhāke nyūna || 94 ||

uddhava akrura — Uddhava and Akrura; mora priya dui-jana — two dear ones of Mine; acharya basaha tumi — the Acharya you consider; ta-sabhake nyuna — lower than they

94"Uddhava and Akrura are two dear ones of Mine —
and you think the Acharya lower than they?

ভারতবরষে এই আচার্য সমান ।
আমার ভকত আছে হেন কোন জন ॥ ৯৫ ॥

bhāratabaraṣe ei ācārya samāna |
āmāra bhakata āche hena kona jana || 95 ||

bharata-varashe — in Bharata-varsha; ei acharya samana — equal to this Acharya; amara bhakata achhe — is there a devotee of Mine; hena kona jana — any such person

95Is there in Bharata-varsha
a single devotee of Mine equal to the Acharya?

এতেক বলিয়ে তুমি অজ্ঞান ব্রাহ্মণ ।
আচার্য সমান মোর ভক্ত নাহি আন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

eteka baliẏe tumi ajñāna brāhmaṇa |
ācārya samāna mora bhakta nāhi āna || 96 ||

eteka baliye — since you say so; tumi ajnana brahmana — you are an ignorant brahmana; acharya samana — equal to the Acharya; mora bhakta nahi ana — I have no other devotee

96Since you speak so, you are an ignorant brahmana:
I have no other devotee equal to the Acharya.

বৈষ্ণবের রাজা সেই মোর আত্মা বলি ।
জগতের কর্তা তারিবারে আইলা কলি ॥ ৯৭ ॥

baiṣṇabera rājā sei mora ātmā bali |
jagatera kartā tāribāre āilā kali || 97 ||

vaishnavera raja sei — He is the king of the Vaishnavas; mora atma bali — I call Him My soul; jagatera karta — the creator of the world; taribare aila kali — has come to deliver Kali

97He is the king of the Vaishnavas, I call Him My own soul;
the creator of the world has come to deliver [the people of] Kali.

শাস্ত্রে মহাবিষ্ণু বলি' করে নিরূপণ ।
সে জন অদ্বৈত ভক্ত-অবতার জান ॥ ৯৮ ॥

śāstre mahābiṣṇu bali' kare nirūpaṇa |
se jana adbaita bhakta-abatāra jāna || 98 ||

shastre — the shastras; mahavishnu bali — as Maha-Vishnu; kare nirupana — describe; se jana advaita — that Advaita; bhakta-avatara jana — know as the avatara in the form of a devotee

98The shastras describe Him as Maha-Vishnu;
know that this Advaita is the avatara in the form of a devotee.

এতেক কহিয়ে আমি সুদৃঢ় বচন ।
আচার্যের স্তুতি ভক্তি কর সর্বক্ষণ ॥ ৯৯ ॥

eteka kahiẏe āmi sudṛṛha bacana |
ācāryera stuti bhakti kara sarbakṣaṇa || 99 ||

eteka kahiye ami — therefore I say; sudridha bachana — firm words; acharyera stuti bhakti — praise of and devotion to the Acharya; kara sarvakshana — show always

99Therefore I tell you firmly:
always glorify the Acharya and be devoted to Him"8.

এ বোল শুনিঞা বিপ্র অন্তরে তরাস ।
নিঃশবদে রহে বিপ্র মুখে নাহি ভাষ ॥ ১০০ ॥

e bola śuniñā bipra antare tarāsa |
niḥśabade rahe bipra mukhe nāhi bhāṣa || 100 ||

e bola shunina — hearing this; vipra antare tarasa — the brahmana was frightened at heart; nihshabade rahe vipra — the brahmana fell silent; mukhe nahi bhasha — no word in his mouth

100Hearing this, the brahmana was frightened at heart;
the brahmana fell silent, unable to utter a word.

তবে সেই গৌরহরি বোলে পুনর্বার ।
অধ্যাত্ম-চরচা তোরা না করিবি আর ॥ ১০১ ॥

tabe sei gaurahari bole punarbāra |
adhyātma-caracā torā nā karibi āra || 101 ||

tabe sei gaurahari — then Gaurahari; bole punarbara — says again; adhyatma-characha — speculation about the Self; tora na karibi ara — you will no longer engage in

101Then Gaurahari says again:
"You will no longer speculate about the Self.

যদি বা অধ্যাত্মবাদে দেখি শুনি তোমা ।
তবে পুনঃ তো-সভারে নাহি দিব প্রেমা ॥ ১০২ ॥

yadi bā adhyātmabāde dekhi śuni tomā |
tabe punaḥ to-sabhāre nāhi diba premā || 102 ||

yadi ba — if ever; adhyatma-bade — in talk of the Self; dekhi shuni toma — I see or hear you; tabe punah — then again; to-sabhare nahi diba prema — I shall not give you prema

102If I see or hear you speculating about the Self,
I shall no longer give you prema.

জ্ঞান-কর্ম উপেখিলে কৃষ্ণপ্রেমা হয় ।
ইহা জানি' জ্ঞানকর্ম না কর আশ্রয় ॥ ১০৩ ॥

jñāna-karma upekhile kṛṣṇapremā haẏa |
ihā jāni' jñānakarma nā kara āśraẏa || 103 ||

jnana-karma upekhile — if one disregards knowledge and karma; krishna-prema haya — love for Krishna comes; iha jani — knowing this; jnana-karma na kara ashraya — do not take refuge in knowledge and karma

103For one who disregards knowledge and karma, love for Krishna comes;
knowing this, do not take refuge in knowledge and karma."

এ বোল শুনিঞা কহে শ্রীবাসপণ্ডিত ।
এই বর দেহ তাহা পাসরউ চিত ॥ ১০৪ ॥

e bola śuniñā kahe śrībāsapaṇḍita |
ei bara deha tāhā pāsarau cita || 104 ||

e bola shunina — hearing this; kahe shrivasa-pandita — Srivasa Pandita says; ei bara deha — give this boon; taha pasarau chita — may my heart forget it

104Hearing this, Srivasa Pandita says:
"Give me this boon: let my heart forget it."

মুরারি কহিল আমি অধ্যাত্ম না জানি ।
প্রভু কহে কমলাক্ষ হৈতে জান তুমি ॥ ১০৫ ॥

murāri kahila āmi adhyātma nā jāni |
prabhu kahe kamalākṣa haite jāna tumi || 105 ||

murari kahila — Murari said; ami adhyatma na jani — I do not know the doctrine of the Self; prabhu kahe — the Lord says; kamalaksha haite — from Kamalaksha; jana tumi — you know it

105Murari said: "I do not know the doctrine of the Self."
The Lord says: "You know it — from Kamalaksha!9

শুদ্ধচিত্তে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্রে কর দৃঢ় ভক্তি ।
ভক্তিরস-নিকটে চেটিকা হয় মুক্তি ॥ ১০৬ ॥

śuddhacitte kṛṣṇacandre kara dṛṛha bhakti |
bhaktirasa-nikaṭe ceṭikā haẏa mukti || 106 ||

shuddha-chitte — with a pure heart; krishnachandre kara dridha bhakti — have firm devotion to Krishnachandra; bhakti-rasa-nikate — before the rasa of bhakti; chetika haya mukti — liberation is a maidservant

106With a pure heart be firmly devoted to Krishnachandra:
before the rasa of bhakti, liberation is a maidservant."

এ বোল শুনিঞা সভে আনন্দিত মন ।
অন্তরে করিল আজ্ঞা করিব পালন ॥ ১০৭ ॥

e bola śuniñā sabhe ānandita mana |
antare karila ājñā kariba pālana || 107 ||

e bola shunina — hearing these words; sabhe anandita mana — all were glad at heart; antare karila — in their hearts resolved; ajna kariba palana — we shall carry out the order

107Hearing these words, all rejoiced
and in their hearts accepted the order: "We shall carry it out."

হরি-হর-পাদাম্বুজ-মধুমত্ত তারা ।
আনন্দে নাচয়ে তারা দেবতার পারা ॥ ১০৮ ॥

hari-hara-pādāmbuja-madhumatta tārā |
ānande nācaẏe tārā debatāra pārā || 108 ||

hari-hara-padambuja — of the lotus feet of Hari-Hara; madhu-matta tara — intoxicated with the honey; anande nachaye tara — they dance in joy; devatara para — like gods

108Intoxicated with the honey of the lotus feet of Hari-Hara,
they dance in joy like gods10.

হেন অপরূপ কথা নদীয়া-বিহার ।
কহিল লোচন গোরা-প্রেমার প্রচার ॥ ১০৯ ॥

hena aparūpa kathā nadīẏā-bihāra |
kahila locana gorā-premāra pracāra || 109 ||

hena aparupa katha — such a wondrous story; nadiya-vihara — of the pastimes in Nadia; kahila lochana — Lochana has told; gora-premara prachara — Gora's preaching of prema

109Such is the wondrous story of the pastimes in Nadia:
Lochana has told how Gora preached prema.

Raga sindhura

অরুণ-কমল-আঁখি, তারক ভ্রমর-পাখী,
ডুবুডুবু করুণা-মকরন্দ ।
বদন পূর্ণিমার চান্দে, ছটায় পরাণ কান্দে,
তাহে কত প্রেমার আরম্ভ ॥ ১১০ ॥

aruṇa-kamala-āṁkhi, tāraka bhramara-pākhī,
ḍubuḍubu karuṇā-makaranda |
badana pūrṇimāra cānde, chaṭāẏa parāṇa kānde,
tāhe kata premāra ārambha || 110 ||

aruna-kamala-ankhi — eyes like red lotuses; taraka bhramara-pakhi — the pupils are bees; dubudubu karuna-makaranda — drowning in the nectar of compassion; badana purnimara chande — the face a full moon; chhataya parana kande — at its radiance the heart weeps; tahe kata premara arambha — how many beginnings of prema in it

110His eyes are red lotuses, the pupils bees
drowning in the nectar of compassion.
His face is the full moon: at its radiance the heart weeps;
how many beginnings of prema are in it!

Refrain: "The town of Nadia rejoices: swaying under the weight of prema, the moon, Shachi's darling, dances. They cry 'Jaya, jaya!' and auspicious words; seeing Him, all are amazed — the King of dancers, the enchanter of Madana!"

পুলক ভরিল গায়, ঘর্ম বিন্দু-বিন্দু তায়,
লোমচক্রে সোনার কদম্ব ।
প্রেমার আরম্ভে তনু, যেন প্রাতঃকালের ভানু,
আধবাণী রাখে কম্বুকণ্ঠ ॥ ১১১ ॥

pulaka bharila gāẏa, gharma bindu-bindu tāẏa,
lomacakre sonāra kadamba |
premāra ārambhe tanu, yena prātaḥkālera bhānu,
ādhabāṇī rākhe kambukaṇṭha || 111 ||

pulaka bharila gaya — the body full of thrill; gharma bindu-bindu taya — drops of sweat on it; loma-chakre sonara kadamba — the bristling hairs a golden kadamba; premara arambhe tanu — at the onset of prema the body; yena pratah-kalera bhanu — like the morning sun; adha-vani rakhe kambu-kantha — the conch-throat holds back half-words

111His body is full of thrill, with drops of sweat upon it;
the hairs on end — like a golden kadamba.
At the onset of prema His body is like the morning sun;
His conch-like throat holds back half-spoken words.

শ্রীপাদপদুম-গন্ধে, বেড়ি' দশ নখ-চান্দে,
উপরে কনক-বঙ্ক রাজে ।
যখন ভাতিয়া চলে, বিজুরী ঝলমল করে,
চমকিত অমর-সমাজে ॥ ১১২ ॥

śrīpādapaduma-gandhe, beṛi' daśa nakha-cānde,
upare kanaka-baṅka rāje |
yakhana bhātiẏā cale, bijurī jhalamala kare,
camakita amara-samāje || 112 ||

shri-pada-paduma-gandhe — in the fragrance of the lotus feet; bedi dasha nakha-chande — ringed by ten nail-moons; upare kanaka-banka raje — above shine golden anklets; yakhana bhatiya chale — when He walks shining; bijuri jhalamala kare — lightning flashes; chamakita amara-samaje — the assembly of gods is astonished

112In the fragrance of His lotus feet, ringed by ten moons of nails,
above them shine golden anklets.
When He walks, shining, lightning flashes;
the assembly of the gods is astonished.

সপ্তদ্বীপা মহী-মাঝে, তাহে নবদ্বীপ সাজে,
তাহে নব প্রেমার প্রকাশ ।
তাহে নব গৌরহরি, হরি-গুণকীর্তন করি',
আনন্দিত এ ভূমি-আকাশ ॥ ১১৩ ॥

saptadbīpā mahī-mājhe, tāhe nabadbīpa sāje,
tāhe naba premāra prakāśa |
tāhe naba gaurahari, hari-guṇakīrtana kari',
ānandita e bhūmi-ākāśa || 113 ||

saptadvipa mahi-majhe — in the midst of the earth of seven continents; tahe navadvipa saje — Navadvipa is adorned; tahe nava premara prakasha — in it a new manifestation of prema; tahe nava gaurahari — there the new Gaurahari; hari-guna-kirtana kari — singing Hari's qualities; anandita e bhumi-akasha — earth and sky rejoice

113In the midst of the earth of seven continents Navadvipa is adorned,
and in it a new manifestation of prema;
there the new Gaurahari sings the kirtana of Hari's qualities —
earth and sky rejoice.

সিংহের শাবক যেন, গম্ভীর গর্জন ঘন,
হুঙ্কার-হিল্লোল প্রেম-সিন্ধু ।
হরিহরি-বোল বোলে, জগত পড়িল ভোলে,
দু-কূল খাইল কুলবধূ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

siṃhera śābaka yena, gambhīra garjana ghana,
huṅkāra-hillola prema-sindhu |
harihari-bola bole, jagata paṛila bhole,
du-kūla khāila kulabadhū || 114 ||

simhera shabaka yena — like a lion cub; gambhira garjana ghana — roaring deeply again and again; hunkara-hillola prema-sindhu — "hum!", the waves of the ocean of prema; hari-hari-bola bole — He cries "Hari, Hari!"; jagata padila bhole — the world fell into rapture; du-kula khaila kula-badhu — the wives of noble houses lost both houses

114Like a lion cub, He roars deeply again and again;
"hum!" — the waves of the ocean of prema.
He cries "Hari, Hari!" — and the world fell into rapture,
and the wives of noble houses forgot the honour of both houses11.

অঙ্গের ছটায় যেন, দিনকর দীপ হেন,
তাহে লীলা-বেশের বিলাস ।
কোটি কুসুমধনু, জিনিঞা বিনোদ তনু,
তাহে করে প্রেমার প্রকাশ ॥ ১১৫ ॥

aṅgera chaṭāẏa yena, dinakara dīpa hena,
tāhe līlā-beśera bilāsa |
koṭi kusumadhanu, jiniñā binoda tanu,
tāhe kare premāra prakāśa || 115 ||

angera chhataya — by the radiance of His body; yena dinakara dipa hena — the sun is like a lamp; tahe lila-beshera vilasa — in it the play of lila and attire; koti kusuma-dhanu — millions of flower-bowed Kamadevas; jinina vinoda tanu — surpassing, the charming body; tahe kare premara prakasha — in it He reveals prema

115By the radiance of His body the sun is like a lamp;
in it is the play of lila and attire.
His charming body surpasses millions of flower-bowed Kamadevas;
in it He reveals prema.

লাখ লাখ পূর্ণিমার চান্দে, জিনিঞা বদন-ছান্দে,
তাহে চারু চন্দন-চন্দ্রিমা ।
নয়ান-অঞ্চল চলে, ঝরি' অমিয়া ঝরে,
জনম-মুগধে পায় প্রেমা ॥ ১১৬ ॥

lākha lākha pūrṇimāra cānde, jiniñā badana-chānde,
tāhe cāru candana-candrimā |
naẏāna-añcala cale, jhari' amiẏā jhare,
janama-mugadhe pāẏa premā || 116 ||

lakha lakha purnimara chande — hundreds of thousands of full moons; jinina badana-chhande — surpassing by the form of His face; tahe charu chandana-chandrima — on it lovely moon-marks of sandal; nayana-anchala chale — when the corners of the eyes move; jhari amiya jhare — nectar streams; janama-mugdhe paya prema — even those deluded from birth obtain prema

116The form of His face surpasses hundreds of thousands of full moons,
and on it are lovely moon-marks of sandal.
When the corners of His eyes move, nectar streams forth:
even those deluded from birth obtain prema.

মাতিল-কুঞ্জর-গতি, ভাবে গরগর অতি,
ক্ষণে হাসে চমকিয়া চায় ।
কামিনী-মোহন বেশ, হেরিয়া ভুলিল দেশ,
মদন-বেদন হেরি' পায় ॥ ১১৭ ॥

mātila-kuñjara-gati, bhābe garagara ati,
kṣaṇe hāse camakiẏā cāẏa |
kāminī-mohana beśa, heriẏā bhulila deśa,
madana-bedana heri' pāẏa || 117 ||

matila-kunjara-gati — the gait of an intoxicated elephant; bhave garagara ati — wholly overwhelmed by bhava; kshane hase — now He laughs; chamakiya chaya — starts and looks around; kamini-mohana besha — an appearance enchanting women; heriya bhulila desha — seeing it, the land lost its head; madana-bedana heri paya — seeing, they feel the pain of love

117His gait is that of an intoxicated elephant, He is wholly in the grip of bhava;
now He laughs, now starts and looks around.
His appearance enchants women; seeing Him, the whole land lost its head,
seeing [Him], they feel the pain of love.

কি দিব উপমা তার, করুণাবিগ্রহ-সার,
হেনরূপে মোর গোরারায় ।
প্রেমায় নদীয়া-লোকে, নাহি নিশি-দিশি তাকে,
আনন্দে লোচনদাসে গায় ॥ ১১৮ ॥

ki diba upamā tāra, karuṇābigraha-sāra,
henarūpe mora gorārāẏa |
premāẏa nadīẏā-loke, nāhi niśi-diśi tāke,
ānande locanadāse gāẏa || 118 ||

ki diba upama tara — what comparison can I give Him; karuna-vigraha-sara — the essence of compassion embodied; hena-rupe mora goraraya — such is my Gora-raya; premaya nadiya-loke — in prema the people of Nadia; nahi nishi-dishi take — know neither night nor day; anande lochanadase gaya — joyfully sings Lochana Dasa

118To what shall I compare Him — the essence of compassion embodied?
Such is my Gora-raya.
In prema the people of Nadia know neither night nor day;
joyfully sings Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. Vv. 36–46 (as in Murari, 2.5.20–28) set out the path of knowledge (jnana-yoga) as those seeking liberation understand it; the Lord expounds it in order then to place bhakti above everything (vv. 47–49) and to forbid speculation about the Self (vv. 101–106). In v. 42 the 1983 edition has "without bhakti" instead of "without liberation". According to the teaching of the Gaudiya Vaishnavas (and of Bhaktisiddhanta), Krishna is reached by bhakti alone ("bhaktyaham ekaya grahyah", Bhagavata 11.14.21), and liberation is not a precondition but a by-product of devotion.
  2. "Knowledge" here is the understanding that Krishna is Bhagavan Himself; it leads to firm faith and to causeless, uninterrupted bhakti (cf. Bhagavata 1.2.7). Cf. Murari 2.5.29–30.
  3. Cf. the Brahma-samhita (5.29, 5.56) and en/24, note 11. On Lakshmi's longing for the rasa of Vraja see Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 9. Vv. 56–58 — cf. Murari 2.5.30–33.
  4. Cf. Murari 2.6.1–6. The hater of devotees is perhaps the brahmana Gopala Chapala, struck with leprosy for offending Srivasa (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 17).
  5. Cf. Murari 2.6.7–9. "To go to the forest" hints at the coming sannyasa.
  6. According to Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, the Lord descended in answer to the loud calls (hunkaras) and worship of Advaita, who offered tulasi leaves and Ganga water to the Shalagrama (Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 3). Cf. Murari 2.6.10–13.
  7. The "children" are Advaita's sons (Achyutananda and others) or His disciples. Cf. Murari 2.6.14–15.
  8. Cf. Murari 2.6.16–22. So too in Gaudiya Vaishnava theology: Advaita is Maha-Vishnu, who has taken the form of a devotee (bhakta-avatara); Chaitanya-charitamrita, Adi 6. Kamalaksha is Advaita's worldly name.
  9. That is, "you heard it from Advaita". According to the Chaitanya-bhagavata (Madhya 19), Advaita for a time deliberately preached the doctrine of the Self (the Yoga-vasishtha) so as to provoke the Lord's punishment. Cf. Murari 2.6.23–26.
  10. "Hari-Hara" — so also in Murari (2.6.27); probably Hari is Gaura, and Hara is Advaita, revered as one with Sadashiva.
  11. That is, they cast aside the honour of both their fathers' and their husbands' houses — an image from the songs of the gopis; cf. Lochana Dasa's "nagari-bhava" (en/09, note 9).
